focus_areas: Structural integrity of thin metal scrolls
Consistency of perspective in background architecture
Clarity of junctions between decorative elements and frame
Verification of material appearance (metal vs. plastic/melted)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: The Router identified significant deviations from the 'staircase incline' definition in the taxonomy. Please evaluate if this constitutes a class mismatch (i.e., is it a 'balustrade' but not a 'bannister'?) or if the class label is broad enough to include landing railings. Also, scrutinize the 'softness' of the metal edges for signs of generative blur versus just low image resolution.
image_description: A close-up view of a black wrought-iron bannister or railing system. The design features ornate scrollwork with spiral and curved metal elements filling the space between vertical supports, rather than simple cylindrical balusters. A horizontal top rail runs along the top, supported by thicker vertical posts (newel posts) at intervals. The background shows a blurred interior setting with light coming through windows.

expert_testimonies.reason: To check for depth consistency between the foreground railing and the background window, and to detect any melting of the thin metal bars into the background.
To verify if the image is correctly classified as a bannister/railing system despite the deviation from standard 'staircase' geometry.
